the window — panes and lead as a made aperture

Bimba / pratibimba — the Original prior in being, later in recognition
the white light carrying plenitude — the possibility of differentiated colour
the ordered spectrum — QL as harmonic articulation of the source
no pane numbered, traditioned or coloured by decree
panes — transmission and obstruction, not an opaque mosaic
the lead cames — holding neighbours in relation while marking where one passage ends
MEF — the refractive operation of declared media, angles, transformations, exclusions
the correction — the lead to the apparatus; QL to the light; MEF not an outside authority
the changing projection
the invested viewer — body, position, attention, concern entering what is seen
the 180°→360° contextual turn — positions and transitions held together
the atlas complement — charts and transitions retain what light-through-glass cannot do
the window — its determinacy retained, recognition giving it return

Bohm — resonant-with, not extraction; no optical proof
